{"rules": ["Model consistently underestimates the magnitude of upward spikes when recent history shows a strong recovery trend (e.g., Example 3-5 where price jumps from ~80 to >90).", "Forecast horizon bias: Model predicts a smooth, linear uptrend but true outcomes exhibit high volatility with sharp peaks followed by mean reversion.", "Sentiment signal lag: Positive sentiment spikes (0.40) in the last 18 days precede the price surge; model fails to weight this leading indicator sufficiently.", "Correction heuristic: Apply an upward bias multiplier of +2% to +5% to the model's 30d forecast when the last 5 days show a net positive trend and sentiment > 0.20.", "Avoid linear extrapolation in volatile regimes; true outcomes often overshoot the model's projected path by 10-15 EUR before correcting."]
